definition: עַ֫יִשׁ noun feminine a constellation, perhaps Great Bear (compare especially Di ) (point perh, עִיֻּשׁ (see Bu and references), compare Syriac PS 2866 , Brock ., name of a star); — עַלבָּֿנֶיהָ ׳ וְע Job 38:22 = עָשׁ Job 9:9 (both + כִּימָה , כְּסִיל etc.). עַיָּת proper name, of a location see ׳ עַ
